name: stamp
description: The Energy fleet's compliance / enterprise-readiness domain-expert employee as one installable Claude Code plugin: bundles the `stamp` CLI, the `stamp` stdio MCP server, the five compliance skills, the compliance-lint hook, and the two sub-agent personas. Install to gap-scan an app for SOC2/ISO27001/HIPAA audit-readiness, plan the enterprise-SSO program (and hand the SAML/SCIM mechanism to badge), design a tamper-evident audit trail, scope access-reviews to agent identities, prove whole-pipeline residency, automate DSARs, and answer SIG/CAIQ from a versioned KB — always 'audit-ready evidence', never 'we're compliant'. Boundary: governance/evidence ONLY — the auth mechanism is badge. Powered by Energy.

hook.name: compliance-lint
hook.description: Parse-time block of stamp's own anti-slop violations in staged output: a 'we are SOC 2 compliant' claim before a CPA signs (OP O24 / KP P7), an 'AI-pentest covers us' claim (OP O20 / KP P18), an auto-revoke without a human gate (OP O19 / KP P6), and a secret committed to git. An isRejecting() guard lets stamp's own forbidding prose (brain/skills that NAME the anti-pattern only to refuse it) pass clean.

install_instructions: 1. Install deps + build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build (so dist/mcp/server.js exists).  2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select the stamp repo root.  3. The stamp CLI (`stamp --help`), the 8 MCP tools (stamp_audit / stamp_sso_plan / …), the 5 skills, the 2 sub-agent personas (stamp-soc2-gap-auditor, stamp-dsar-handler), and the compliance-lint hook are now available; the stamp MCP server is wired via .mcp.json (Vanta/Drata creds as ${env-refs}, no live keys). HARD invariant: stamp emits 'audit-ready evidence', never 'we're compliant', and routes the auth mechanism (SAML/SCIM) to badge — never hand-rolled code (OP O2 / KP P25).
